title: Simple Recipe Enchanted Golden Apple
description: A simple datapack recipe for an Enchanted Golden Apple works by adding a custom crafting recipe to the game without modifying the base files.
body: This simple datapack adds a crafting recipe for the Enchanted Golden Apple, allowing players to obtain this rare item through survival gameplay instead of only finding it in loot structures. It is designed to stay balanced while still feeling rewarding, making late-game progression more meaningful. The recipe fits naturally into vanilla Minecraft, keeping the original survival experience but giving players a clear goal to work toward. This datapack is lightweight, compatible with most worlds, and perfect for players who want a more accessible yet still challenging way to craft one of the most powerful items in the game.
